title: Android image identity and promotion manifest
description: Auditable identity, provenance, authorization, and promotion record for an Android guest/host/OCI artifact tuple. Private signing material and other secrets are intentionally not representable.

tuple_digest.description: Digest of a canonical encoding containing guest digest, host package digest, runtime binary digests, and selected OCI platform manifest digest.

signingKeyIdentity.description: Public identity metadata only. Private keys, passphrases, tokens, and secret material are forbidden by the closed property set.
